lj-000.title: KIRA

dialectExpressions.meaning: Join me to salute, reverence, and pay highest homage to them (KIRA is Yoruba for paying royal honor).
Paternal praise poetry (Oriki): 'Ajayi, the wealthy one of the forest, a man of valor worth three men!'
Maternal praise poetry (Oriki): 'Amope, the glowing fair-complexioned beauty, my beloved mother!'
Philosophical proverb: 'You are the sturdy protective tree standing tall behind my fence' (my ultimate shelter, defense, and backbone).

dialectExpressions.phrase: Iya ni wura baba ni jigi ko s’eni fe j’ataare e laye
dialectExpressions.meaning: Iconic African proverb: 'Mother is pure gold, father is a reflective mirror; no one wants to chew bitter alligator pepper alone in this world' (Parents are irreplaceable guardians; life without them is harsh).

dialectExpressions.phrase: even those times wey I fall your hand
dialectExpressions.meaning: Even during moments when I let you down, disappointed you, or went astray.

dialectExpressions.phrase: Ojo ti mo lo gba boolu ti mo d’egbo wale o
dialectExpressions.meaning: Nostalgic memory: 'The day I went to play football and returned home with bleeding wounds (and you nursed me with love).'

dialectExpressions.phrase: The day wey we see food chop, the day wey e no dey at all
dialectExpressions.meaning: Gratitude for resilience: 'The prosperous days of plenty, and the lean austere days when there was nothing to eat at all.'

lj-000.canonicalLyrics:
I was weak and helpless
You held me and made me strong
I was rough and I was reckless
You taught me to right my wrongs
You were with me all the way, even those times wey I fall your hand
Shey na the loving and affection plus those ones wey I no deserve

I will always remember the good and the ugly times
I will never forget the pains and the sacrifice
Cos iya ni wura baba ni jigi ko s’eni fe j’ataare e laye

*HOOK*
E ba mi kira fun
Ajayi olola iju okunrin meta
E ba mi kira fun
Amope aponbepore mi owon 
E ba mi kira fun
Eyin n’igi leyin ogba mi
E ba mi kira fun
Awon obi mi owon

*Verse II*
I was young and I was stubborn; you stood firm to guide me right
I was blind and I was pompous,
You guided me to the light
You were with me all the way, even those times wey I fall your hand
Shey na the loving and affection plus those ones wey I no deserve 

I will never forget the great memories we had
Ojo ti mo lo gba boolu ti mo d’egbo wale o
The day wey we see food chop, the day wey e no dey at all

Oh oh oh oh

E ba mi kira fun

E ba mi kira fun
Awon obi mi owon

fr.title: KIRA (Traduction Française)
fr.chorus: Aidez-moi à les saluer et leur rendre hommage (E ba mi kira fun)... Mes chers parents adorés (Awon obi mi owon).
fr.fullLyrics:
J'étais faible et sans défense
Tu m'as soutenu et m'as rendu fort
J'étais turbulent et insouciant
Tu m'as appris à réparer mes erreurs
Tu étais avec moi tout au long du chemin, même quand je t'ai déçu
N'est-ce pas ton amour et ton affection, que je ne méritais même pas ?

Je me souviendrai toujours des bons et des mauvais moments
Je n'oublierai jamais les peines et les sacrifices
Car la mère est de l'or, le père est un miroir, personne ne veut affronter la vie seul dans l'amertume

*REFRAIN*
Aidez-moi à les saluer et leur rendre hommage
Ajayi, seigneur distingué, homme vaillant qui vaut trois hommes
Aidez-moi à les saluer et leur rendre hommage
Amope au teint radieux, ma bien-aimée
Aidez-moi à les saluer et leur rendre hommage
Vous êtes le grand arbre protecteur derrière ma clôture
Aidez-moi à les saluer et leur rendre hommage
Mes chers parents bien-aimés
